resources.string: Put the phone flat on a table, away from fans, AC and open windows. Press Start and do not touch it for 11 seconds.
No barometer found. This phone cannot be a reliable vario. You can still run the test for the motion sensors.
Done. Press Copy report and paste it into the chat.
Test cancelled because the app left the screen. Press Start again.
This phone has no barometer and no motion sensors. The vario cannot run.
SENSOR STOPPED. Vario is not working!
Waiting for GPS. Go outside under open sky and check that Location is on.
This phone has no barometer, so the vario works from GPS height. Please allow precise location and press Start again.
Tap to open. Press STOP in the app to end.
Move the slider to hear the sound for any climb or sink rate (m/s). Climb: beeps, higher and faster as it gets stronger. Height loss: slow low tones, then a continuous tone in strong sink.

This app is a flight aid, not a certified instrument. Never rely on it alone; fly with a proven vario as your main instrument.

On phones without a barometer the app works from GPS height. It tells you whether you are gaining or losing height, about 3 to 5 seconds after it happens. The number is only approximate.

On phones with a barometer, keep the phone in a closed pouch out of direct airflow.
Motion sensor not calibrated. Press Calibrate once before using the vario.
Hold the phone still in each of the six positions for about 2 seconds, in any order. Resting it against a wall or a box helps. It does not have to be perfectly level.
Waiting for the phone to be still…
Calibration failed: the readings do not fit. Press Start again and hold the phone more still.

Saved.
Offset (m/s²): %1$s
Scale: %2$s
Restart the vario to use it.
Mode: GPS height (this phone has no barometer). Works in any position, also in a pocket. Reacts in about 3–5 seconds.
GPS %1$.1f fixes/s · noise %2$s m · accuracy ±%3$s m
GPS is weak here. Vario is muted until the signal improves (needs open sky).
